hits.snippet: # Continent 8 taps tech veteran Mike Small as CEO to lead next phase of growth #### **Global iGaming and sports betting IT solutions provider [Continent 8 Technologies](https://agbrief.com/news/world/28/05/2026/continent-8-releases-intelligence8-suite-ai-solutions/) has appointed [Mike Small](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mikepsmall/) as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective 15 July 2026. He succeeds founder Michael Tobin, who is stepping into the role of Chairman after 28 years at the helm.** Mike Small brings over 25 years of global leadership experience across the technology sector. Before joining Continent 8, he served as President of Akkodis North America and US Country President at The Adecco Group, where he oversaw large-scale technology, engineering, managed services, and workforce solutions operations. During his tenure, he played a pivotal role in shaping the group’s AI strategy, driving the adoption of artificial intelligence to help clients accelerate innovation, enhance operational efficiency, and prepare for the future of work.
